sections.title: Return Policy
sections.body: We accept returns within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unworn, unwashed, and in their original packaging with all tags attached. Footwear must be tried on indoors only.

sections.title: How to Return
sections.body: Initiate a return through your account dashboard or contact our support team. We'll provide a prepaid return label. Drop your package at any authorized shipping location.

sections.title: Refunds
sections.body: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive your return. The amount will be credited to your original payment method. You'll receive an email confirmation.

sections.title: Exchanges
sections.body: Exchanges are processed as a return and new purchase for fastest service. Place a new order for the desired item and return the original for a full refund.

sections.title: Non-Returnable Items
sections.body: Final sale items, gift cards, and accessories (socks, laces, care kits) cannot be returned. Please inspect your order upon delivery.
